meta.title: Buyer requests re-evaluation of selected line items

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and a vendor response awaiting evaluation.
Navigate to the event's Technical Stage where re-evaluation can be requested.

args.goal: as the buyer or Procurement Owner, open Technical Stage Settings, select Request for Re-Evaluation, enter a reason, select the specified TR Submitted line items, send the request, and stop when those line items show Re-evaluation Requested

steps.note: Perform the catalog's unsupported buyer-side re-evaluation workflow, including selecting line items and sending the request.
Verify that the requested line items display the expected re-evaluation status.
